findings.description: All review findings against the WEFLOW harness rules. Empty array if the diff is clean.

class.description: Stable kebab-case slug for the issue category, reused across PRs so recurrence can be counted. Examples: fsd-import, hardcoded-color, hardcoded-secret, dead-link, missing-test, low-coverage, dup-component, weak-responsive, missing-focus-state, cta-misroute, content-not-extracted, next16-misuse.

path.description: Repo-relative file path the finding refers to, or null if not file-specific.

line.description: Line number on the RIGHT side of the diff, or null if not applicable.

body.description: Actionable detail: what is wrong and how to fix it.

systemic.description: true if this is a class of issue the harness should prevent (rule/checklist/hook); false if it is a one-off code bug with no general lesson.

harness_hint.description: Which .claude rule SHOULD have caught this (e.g. coding-rules.md#10 FSD, design-system.md color tokens), or the literal 'harness-gap' if no rule covers it yet, or null.
